questions.stem: According to the passage, why was Justin Stewart hospitalized?
options: A workplace accident
Extreme tiredness and an infection
A car accident while driving between jobs
A disagreement with his manager
questions.evidence: he had to be hospitalized for extreme tiredness and an infection
questions.explanation_ko: 그는 극심한 피로와 감염으로 병원에 입원해야 했다고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT one of the suggestions given for setting work boundaries?
options: Scheduling your daily tasks, including breaks
Practicing what to say before turning down a request
Asking a manager to reduce your salary
Moving an email app to a different page on your phone
questions.evidence: Experts also suggest using an email signature as another tool to manage expectations.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에 급여를 줄여 달라고 요청하라는 조언은 없습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about why Amber Krasinski often says "not yet" instead of a firm no?
options: She believes clients never accept a refusal.
She fears turning down work directly could hurt her business.
She only works with clients who never ask for extra projects.
She has never had to decline a project before.
questions.evidence: Krasinski worries that she will lose business if she turns down a project
questions.explanation_ko: 그는 프로젝트를 거절하면 사업을 잃을까 봐 걱정한다고 했으므로, 직접적인 거절을 꺼리는 이유를 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author include the doctor's quote telling Stewart "You're going to have to quit something"?
options: To show the seriousness of the health consequences that led Stewart to change his habits
To promote a specific medicine
To criticize doctors in general
To explain how hospitals operate
questions.evidence: You’re going to have to quit something.
questions.explanation_ko: 이 인용문은 스튜어트가 습관을 바꾸게 된 건강 문제의 심각성을 보여 주기 위해 쓰였습니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "caught up with him" mean in "his busy work life finally caught up with him"?
options: helped him succeed
eventually caused him harm
was forgotten by him
made him famous
questions.evidence: his busy work life finally caught up with him
questions.explanation_ko: 여기서 caught up with him은 결국 그에게 안 좋은 영향을 미쳤다는 뜻입니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 스튜어트는 시간이 지나면서 바쁜 업무 생활이 결국 자신에게 부담으로 돌아왔다고 말했다.
주변 사람들은 제 열정을 칭찬했지만, 저는 결국 그 대가를 치렀습니다.
하지만 그것은 실제로 당신의 시간에 대한 더 많은 통제력을 줄 수 있다.
많은 사람들은 이미 동료와 관리자 양쪽의 업무 요청을 거절하는 데 어려움을 겪는다.

key_points: Experts say learning to set work boundaries and say no is important for protecting workers' physical and mental health, and it gets easier with practice.
Justin Stewart worked multiple jobs and became so overworked he was hospitalized, which led him to give up side jobs and start declining after-hours work.
Many people struggle to turn down requests from coworkers or managers because they want to feel needed or please others.
Suggestions for setting boundaries include scheduling your time deliberately, practicing what to say when declining, and knowing which tasks or interactions drain your energy.
Technology can also help, such as moving email apps out of easy reach on weekends or using an email signature to communicate working hours.
main_idea: Experts say learning to set boundaries and say no at work, though difficult, is important for protecting health, and they offer practical strategies to make it easier.
restate_sentence: These limits can be important in helping workers protect their physical and mental health.
